note: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Wortliste, alphabetical part, letters a to k, only entries that are NOT on the A1 or A2 list (B1 new). Taken from the third-party transcription github.com/ilkermeliksitki/goethe-institute-wordlist (b1/*.tsv), normalized by hand. The transcription itself has page gaps: a (between anstellen and aufgeben), e (between ernähren and es), g (Geld, gehören area), h (between halten and Handel). Words in those gaps are missing here and must be filled from the official PDF. Pure affixes (Bio-, Doppel-, Groß-, Haupt-, ein- and similar) and fragments were dropped. region is set only where the transcription marks the entry (CH = Swiss, A = Austrian, D = German). month is an editorial assignment for this course, not part of the list. Not yet cross-checked against the official PDF. Wortgruppen not included. Private study use only. | 2026-10-12 괴테 공식 PDF와 대조, 빠진 표제어를 더함(added 칸). 여성형(-in)은 남성형 카드로 함께 다룬다.
